title: Release, deployment and CI
scope: Root scripts, .github workflows, app packaging and tools/deploy

claims.statement: Root scripts define tsc project-reference compilation, Vite renderer bundling, Vitest, ESLint, formatting and design generation. CI declares Node 22/24 lanes plus desktop and smoke workflows.
The standalone deployment tool stages releases and coordinates activation with process/admission checks, a pending journal, systemd stop/start, symlink selection and recovery.
Activation compatibility compares storeEpoch; store changes requiring a different epoch are refused rather than migrated automatically.
Desktop packages target Linux/macOS/Windows; mac signing/notarization is explicitly disabled in configuration. Publication waits for selected build/verification jobs.

limits: No workflow, deployment helper, packaging command or integration test was executed. Environment-provided signing, SSH and feed secrets were not read.
